verdict.rationale: No evidence describes an Orama policy, setting, or contractual commitment about AI training on customer data. Users can only keep data under their own control indirectly: the open-source library runs in their own application, and Orama Cloud's context server can be deployed on-premise on their own infrastructure. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data policy or opt-out control, documentation of how data is handled when queries are proxied to third-party LLMs, and independent corroboration.
